$comment: Ionity board catalog — known ESP32 variants. Keyed by board_id. Used by the provisioner to pick the right PlatformIO env, display driver, and pinout.

esp32s3_n16r8.label: GOOUUU / Generic ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1 (N16R8)
esp32s3_n16r8.notes: Base CSI sensing node. No onboard display.

esp32s3_touch_amoled_1_64.label: Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch-AMOLED-1.64 (CO5300)
esp32s3_touch_amoled_1_64.notes: 1.64" rounded-rectangle AMOLED 280x456 (CO5300 QSPI). Pins + offsets verified against Arduino_GFX dev-device table (WAVESHARE_ESP32_S3_TOUCH_AMOLED_1_64). Requires Arduino_GFX >= 1.6.5.

esp32s3_touch_amoled_1_8.label: Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch-AMOLED-1.8 (SH8601)
esp32s3_touch_amoled_1_8.notes: Supported by ESP-IDF firmware tree (firmware/esp32-csi-node) via CONFIG_DISPLAY_ENABLE. ADR-045.
